# How long the harness module's slow tests take on a GitHub runner (4 vCPU,
# go test -race, the default MIMICRY_PROFILES), in seconds. Read by
# .github/scripts/harness-shard.sh to split the tests into CI shards; a test
# not listed counts as 2 seconds. Taken from the runner's logs (each shard's
# log has every test's --- PASS line with its duration; go test's ok line
# the package's). The parallel tests (HTTP/3, the edge scenarios, the
# interop) are bound by -parallel, which is the runner's 4 CPUs: they take
# about the sum of their subtests over 4, far longer than on a many-core Mac.
#
# A slow test needs a line here, or the shard it lands in can run past the
# 15-minute limit: `bash .github/scripts/harness-shard.sh plan 8` prints the
# split. `Test/regex` runs a slice of a test's subtests as its own unit (a
# test whose subtests alone take longer than a shard should); the subtests no
# slice matches run as one more unit. `TestA|TestB` keeps tests in one unit.
#
# seconds  package          test[/subtests]
320        ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles/^chrome-
145        ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles/^firefox-
145        ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles/^safari-
135        ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures
100        ./cmd/h3gen      TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles
25         ./cmd/h3gen      TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures
25         ./cmd/kindsgen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles
7          ./cmd/kindsgen   TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures
# 48 subtests of about 50 s, 4 at a time: about 610 s whole on a 4-CPU
# Linux box, so a slice per profile.
155        ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^chrome-.*-macos
155        ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^chrome-.*-windows
155        ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^firefox-
155        ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^safari-
# Both replay every page capture, decoded once per test binary (pagesOnce,
# nearly all of their time): apart, each would decode them.
190        ./e2e            TestChainedPrioritiesMatchBrowserTraces|TestHPACKReproducesBrowserBlocks
200        ./e2e            TestConnectionMatchesBrowserTrace
90         ./e2e            TestInheritedProfile
105        ./e2e            TestHTTP3MatchesBrowser
70         ./e2e            TestWebSocketsMatchBrowser
60         ./e2e            TestHTTP3DownloadMatchesBrowser
25         ./e2e            TestHTTP3ACKEvery
60         ./e2e            TestQUICInterop
18         ./e2e            TestCORSMatchesBrowser
18         ./e2e            TestDeflateReproducesBrowserMessages
18         ./e2e            TestResumptionMatchesBrowser
6          ./e2e            TestConnectionsMatchBrowser
